description: Start a Fishbowl Advanced database-backup import. Returns an uploadUrl for the customer to upload a MySQL .sql backup or a ZIP containing one SQL backup (up to 20 GB uploaded; the upload page resumes an interrupted upload and must stay open until it finishes) and a reviewUrl. The server restores, extracts and validates automatically; nothing is committed until an admin confirms on the review page. Supports catalog, partners, warehouses/bins, costed and tracked opening stock, fulfilled sales history, manufacturing orders, BOMs and PO history. Remaining production becomes drafts for review; completed production is historical. Source-specific exceptions are reported and stock quantity/value are reconciled. Requires an unpinned write credential with imports.execute. Starting again before a backup is uploaded resumes the same draft with the supplied source timezone and a fresh upload link, replacing its previous link. If a backup was already received, use list_migration_imports/get_migration_import instead. Cin7 Core imports are not started here: never ask for Cin7 Core API credentials in chat; send an account admin to Foundations, where they enter the credential themselves.

sourceTimeZone.description: IANA timezone used by the Fishbowl company, e.g. America/Denver. Ask the customer; do not infer it from the assistant's location.
